content: Trainer: Trainers manage the control flow for the training and validation loop for experiments. They sample batches from one or more tasks, perform forward and backward passes, calculate training metrics, evaluate on a validation set, and save checkpoints. Users can specify experiment-specific parameters such as learning rate, batch size, and more.
